## Open Field Analysis

### Experimental conditions

2 groups of mice:

LOG DATA: _No Crash of the system, all data can be used_

-> all data can be used    

Path to all Raw data files: `~\6. Data from Behavioral Test\analysis\OF`  

Preprocessed Data: 
 
2 groups:  

`cohort1_2025-05-12.xlsx`    
`cohort2_2025-05-12.xlsx`   

The analysis of the data is done in this Rmd file directly.  

Path to Report: `~\6. Data from Behavioral Test\OF`    

### Data Quality:  
->All data can be used. 

```{r OP_data_loading}

# Empty global environment
rm(list = ls())

### 1.0 LOAD IN DATA ----------------------------------------------------------

# Load data
file_path <- "~/6. Data from Behavioral Tests/analysis/OF/"

raw_data_file_c1 <- "cohort1_2025-05-12.xlsx"
raw_data_file_c2 <- "cohort2_2025-05-12.xlsx"

data_c1 <- read_excel(paste(file_path,raw_data_file_c1,sep=""))
data_c2 <- read_excel(paste(file_path,raw_data_file_c2,sep=""))

# combine all groups to create a single data frame 
raw_data <- rbind(data_c1, data_c2)


# Load lookup data files
lookupfile <- choose.files()  

# Read lookup data files
lookup <- read_excel(paste(lookupfile,sep = ""))

lookup <- lookup %>% 
  mutate(animal_no = as.character(`Animal ID`),
         cohort = as.character(cohort)) 

# combine exp data with lookup data
data_of <- full_join(raw_data,lookup , by= "animal_no")

data_of$cohort <- as.numeric(data_of$cohort)

# need genotype to be factor for later stat analysis
data_of <- data_of %>% mutate(group = as.factor(Group)) 


# Combine the lookup file
data <- data_of %>%
  # Select relevant columns
  dplyr::select(no, animal_no, cohort, group, Sex, contains("Tracklength"), contains("Track length"), contains("Track_length"), contains("Visits"), contains("Visit"), contains("Duration")) 

data <- data %>%
  mutate(perc_time_center = as.numeric(`Duration (s) center`)/(as.numeric(`Duration (s) arena`) + as.numeric(`Duration (s) center`)) * 100)

data <- data %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group),
         cohort = factor(cohort),
         gender = factor(Sex)) %>%
  mutate_at(c(6:14),as.numeric)

#lapply(data,class)

```

\newpage

### Analysis of the data

#### Arena track length

```{r OP_track_length, fig.align = "left", fig.width=9, fig.height=4}

### 3.0 ANALYSIS OF THE DATA --------------------------------------------------

### 3.1 DISTANCE TRAVELLED ----------------------------------------------------

# stats fig1a
stat_1a <- data %>%
  filter(no == "Sum") %>%
  wilcox_test(`Track length (cm)` ~ group,exact=FALSE) %>%
  add_significance("p") %>%  
  add_xy_position(x = "group")  # needs to be included

# plot fig1a
pl_1a <- data %>%
  filter(no == "Sum") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = group, y = `Track length (cm)`, color = group, label = "")) +
  geom_boxplot() + 
  geom_point(position=position_jitter(w=0.2, h=0.2)) +  
  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(3000,10500)) +
  labs(title="Distance traveled (10m)", x="", y = "Distance (cm)") + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme_pubr() +
  stat_n_text() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(vjust= 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 12)) +
  stat_pvalue_manual(stat_1a, label = "p.signif", tip.length = 0.02)

#pl_1a

################################# 
# stats fig1b
stat_1b <- data %>%
  filter(no == "Sum") %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  wilcox_test(`Track length (cm)` ~ gender,exact=FALSE) %>%
  add_significance("p") %>%
  add_xy_position(x = "group")  # needs to be included

# plot fig1b
pl_1b <- data %>%
  filter(no == "Sum") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = group, y = `Track length (cm)`, color = gender, label = "")) +
  geom_boxplot() + 
  geom_point(position=position_jitter(w=0.2, h=0.2)) +    
  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(3000,10500)) +
  labs(title="Distance traveled (10m)", x="", y = "Distance (cm)") + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme_pubr() +
  stat_n_text() +
  geom_text(aes(y = after_stat(count), label=after_stat(count)), stat="count", y = 3500, position = position_dodge(width = 0.95,), size=4, show.legend = FALSE) +  
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(vjust= 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 12)) +
  stat_pvalue_manual(stat_1b, label = "p.signif", tip.length = 0.02)

#pl_1b

#################################  
# arrange plots into a grid with automatic sublabels (A,B)
fig1 <- ggarrange(pl_1a, pl_1b, labels="AUTO", ncol=2, nrow=1, common.legend=F, legend = "bottom")

fig1

```

__Figure 1.__ Distance traveled (cm) between groups (A) and between gender within group (B).

__Statistics for Figure 1 A (between groups)__

```{r stat_1a, echo=F}

stat_1a %>%
  dplyr::select(-y.position,-groups,-xmin,-xmax) %>%  
  #remove horizontal lines between rows
  kable(booktabs = T) %>%
  #prevent table from floating and scale it to page-width
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("HOLD_position","scale_down"))

```

__Statistics for Figure 1 B (between gender)__

```{r stat_1b, echo=F}

stat_1b %>%
  dplyr::select(-y.position,-groups,-x,-xmin,-xmax) %>%
  #remove horizontal lines between rows
  kable(booktabs = T) %>%
  #prevent table from floating and scale it to page-width
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("HOLD_position","scale_down"))

```

        plot.title = element_text(vjust= 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 12)) +
  stat_pvalue_manual(stat_5a, label = "p.signif", tip.length = 0.02)

#pl_5a

################################# 

# stats fig5b
stat_5b <- data %>%
    filter(no == "Sum") %>%
    group_by(group) %>%
    wilcox_test(`Duration (s) center` ~ cohort,exact=FALSE) %>%
    add_significance("p") %>%
    add_xy_position(x = "group")

# plot fig5b
pl_5b <- data %>%
  filter(no == "Sum") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = group, y = `Duration (s) center`, color = cohort, label = "")) +
  geom_boxplot() + 
  geom_point(position=position_jitter(w=0.2, h=0.2)) +
#  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,175)) +
  labs(title="Time spent in the center", x="", y = "Time (s)") + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme_pubr() + 
  stat_n_text() +
  geom_text(aes(y = after_stat(count), label=after_stat(count)), stat="count", y = 5, position = position_dodge(width = 0.95,), size=4, show.legend = FALSE) +    
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(vjust= 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 12)) +
  stat_pvalue_manual(stat_5b, label = "p.signif", tip.length = 0.02)

#pl_5b

    add_xy_position(x = "group")

# plot fig5c

#  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(1,14)) +

  theme_classic() +
  theme_pubr() + 
  stat_n_text() +
  geom_text(aes(y = after_stat(count), label=after_stat(count)), stat="count", y = 1, position = position_dodge(width = 0.95,), size=4, show.legend = FALSE) +  
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(vjust= 0, hjust = 0.5, size = 12)) +

#arrange plots into a grid with automatic sublabels (A,B)
fig5 <- ggarrange(pl_5a, pl_5b, pl_5c, pl_5d, labels="AUTO", ncol=2, nrow=2, common.legend=TRUE, legend = "bottom") 

fig5

__Figure 5.__ Comparison between cohorts. Distance traveled (cm) (A), Time spent in the periphery (B) Percentage of the time spent in the center zone (C), and Number of visits to the center zone (D).
